llmJudgeRequirements.reason: preferencesAtom is created with atomWithStorage and createJSONStorage(() => AsyncStorage) as the third argument.
evidence: const preferencesAtom = atomWithStorage<Preferences>(STORAGE_KEY, SAFE_DEFAULT_PREFERENCES, createJSONStorage(() => AsyncStorage))

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Hydration completion is tracked in dedicated atom state
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Hydration completion is tracked via a local useState hook, not in a dedicated Jotai atom state.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Preference-dependent content is gated behind a deterministic pre-hydration UI branch
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The loading branch only gates the profile/loading text, but preference-dependent content (Theme and Compact mode text, toggle buttons) is rendered unconditionally regardless of hydration state.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Hydration action runs first and profile loading is triggered only after hydration completes
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Profile fetch is inside a useEffect that depends on `hydrated`, and only runs when hydrated is true, which is set in a prior useEffect.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Post-hydration profile load fetches the users endpoint and builds preview text from `firstName` and `lastName`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Fetches https://dummyjson.com/users/1 and maps data.firstName and data.lastName into profile state, which is then rendered as 'Profile: {firstName} {lastName}'.
evidence: fetch('https://dummyjson.com/users/1').then(res => res.json()).then(data => { setProfile({ firstName: data.firstName, lastName: data.lastName }) })

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Preference toggle actions update persisted state through functional atom updater paths
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Both toggleTheme and toggleCompact call setPreferences with a functional updater ((previous) => ...) that derives new state from previous state.
